search_text: published ZDI-07-009 ZDI-CAN-133 Novell Netmail WebAdmin Buffer Overflow Vulnerability 2007-03-07 CVE-2007-1350 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2007-1350 ['Novell'] ['NetMail'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Novell NetMail. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists in the webadmin.exe process bound by default on TCP port 89. During HTTP Basic authentication, a long username of at least 213 bytes will trigger a stack based buffer overflow due to a vulnerable sprintf() call. Exploitation of this issue can result in arbitrary code execution. Novell has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Novell Netmail WebAdmin Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Novell NetMail. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists in the webadmin.exe process bound by default on TCP port 89. During HTTP Basic authentication, a long username of at least 213 bytes will trigger a stack based buffer overflow due to a vulnerable sprintf() call. Exploitation of this issue can result in arbitrary code execution.
